C++26 reflection opens the door to eliminating much of the repetitive, error-prone code involved in JSON serialization. In this post, we’ll build on the basics of reflection and explore how it can automatically map the members of a user-defined class to JSON, even as the class evolves.

C++26 Reflection: Simplifying JSON Serialization

by Vivek Bhadra
